skills/benchmark-paper-template.slim: Structure a Benchmark/Evaluation paper with the five-pillar framework (gap, construction pipeline, evaluation, findings, optional method): completeness audit, Introduction logic chain, Section 2-7 skeleton. Use when writing or checking a benchmark paper.

skills/brandkit.slim: Generate premium brand-kit imagery: brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, visual-world presentations; minimalist, cinematic, editorial, luxury or dark-tech directions with intentional logo concepting and mockups.

skills/describe-design.slim: Research a codebase and write architecture documentation: how a feature works, system overview, code structure for onboarding, with Mermaid diagrams and stable code references. For humans and AI agents.

skills/gnomad-database.slim: Query gnomAD: variant rarity and allele frequency, gene constraint (pLI, LOEUF), variants in a region or gene, structural variants. Not for individual patient genomes, somatic cancer mutations (COSMIC) or raw reads (ENA).

skills/idea-evaluator.slim: Evaluate a draft research idea on Higher/Faster/Stronger/Cheaper/Broader, lifecycle and capability fit, paradigm-shift probe and fatal-flaw audit; reviewer-style verdict. Use for 'evaluate/score this idea', feasibility, novelty check, or before fixing paper scope.

skills/image-to-code-skill.slim: Image-to-code for Codex web work: generate section-level design images first, analyze them, then implement the page to match — large readable images, clean hero, no cards-in-cards. For visually important frontend tasks.

skills/imagegen-frontend-mobile.slim: Generate premium app-native mobile screen concepts and flows as images: iOS/Android, clean hierarchy, multi-screen consistency, controlled palettes, phone mockups. Generates images only, no code.

skills/imagegen-frontend-web.slim: Generate premium website design references as images: one horizontal image per section, varied composition and hero scale, one consistent palette. For landing pages and marketing sites a developer can recreate.

skills/interpro-database.slim: Find protein domains, families and sites; list proteins in a family or sharing a domain; species distribution; annotate genomes with InterPro/Pfam families and GO terms; domain architecture (IDA) search across 14 member databases.

skills/intro-drafter.slim: Draft a technical paper's Introduction as flowing prose via a six-paragraph logic (background, limitations, problem, challenges, solution, contributions); aligns contributions with challenges. Use to draft, outline or restructure an Introduction.

skills/lifecycle.slim: Manage R package lifecycle with the lifecycle package: deprecate or rename functions and arguments, supersede, mark experimental, and write deprecation helpers following tidyverse principles.

skills/ljg-book.slim: 拆书：给书名、PDF、EPUB 或节选，讲清全书跟着什么走、主线怎么连、证据如何改变理解，保留书的具体内容而非只给通用结论，默认存 Org 笔记。用户说拆书、分析这本书、这本书在讲什么、压缩一本书时使用。

skills/ljg-constraint.slim: 给领域/专业/角色/产品/争论找真正框住它的几条约束，判世界/规则/解释（硬/软/自设），看约束如何定义身份、框出解空间。用户说找约束、本质约束、硬约束还是自设约束、边界在哪、constraint 时使用；不用于降秩或纵向深钻。

skills/ljg-paper.slim: 讲论文：给 arXiv 链接、PDF 或论文题目，讲清研究了什么、作者贡献、结论如何得出、证据没证明什么，默认存 Org 笔记。用户说要读、分析或理解一篇论文时使用；不做复现、正式同行评审或文献综述。

skills/ljg-qa.slim: 信息提问机：把文章/论文/书的核心观点抽成 Q-A 对，问题切要害、答案简洁有收口，读者顺着 Q 链复现作者推理。用户说问答、Q&A、QA、提问、抽取问题时使用；不用于 FAQ、术语表或阅读理解题。
